text.p: A total of 590,000 shares in Russian natural gas monopoly RAO Gazprom changed hands in electronic trading on Wednesday at an average 3,082 roubles ($0.543) a share, up from 3,054 roubles at the previous session on February 21, the Federal Securities Corporation (FFK) said.
Full details of the trading session:
Gazprom is one of Russia's biggest companies by market capitalisation but its 23.6 billion shares are highly illiquid because of company restrictions on selling them.
The company has organised regular auctions and electronic trading sessions to create an orderly market in its paper.
Gazprom was $0.540 at 1150 GMT on Wednesday on the Russian Trading System, down from $0.541 on Tuesday.
Its American Depositary Shares were $19.875 after $19.950. One ADS is equivalent to 10 ordinary shares.
The next electronic trading sessions will be held on February 27, 28 and March 5, 6, 7, 11, 12, 13 and 14.
